hero.headline: I build mobile experiences with Flutter.
hero.description: Mobile software engineer working across Flutter, native Android, and iOS—from product interfaces to platform integrations.

paragraphs: I'm a mobile software engineer who looks for practical solutions to everyday problems. Flutter is where I'm strongest. I ship with it, and I connect it to native Android and iOS when the product needs to go deeper. I also work with React on the web.

I use AI as part of how I build, and I'm comfortable putting it to work on real product problems. I like working with a team, and I care about clear communication, solid testing, and an experience people actually enjoy.
I’m always up for a new challenge—especially one that pushes me to learn and build something useful.
about.educationTitle: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology

projects.intro: A closer look at the products I’ve helped build and the work behind them.

items.title: Project Management App for Construction Firm
items.overview: An internal iOS app bringing project planning, calendars, and team communication into one place.
items.summary: My role was to develop an iOS application using Flutter and Dart, with Google Maps, REST APIs, Bloc, and Xcode. It was deployed to the App Store by invitation, because it was exclusive to one company.
features: Realtime chat with image, voice, and text

items.title: Delivery App
items.overview: A delivery app connecting driver booking with messaging, authentication, and payments.
items.summary: My role was to develop the front-end and back-end modules and integrate the APIs.

items.title: Social Media App
items.overview: An Android and iOS social app with image sharing, filters, and realtime conversations.
items.summary: My role was to develop and integrate APIs for the Android and iOS modules.

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.description: I work on Maya — savings, loans, and cards — and on Maya Business, the Maya app for businesses. The work is Flutter-first, including the places where Flutter talks to native Android and iOS.

roles.title: Lead Mobile Software Engineer
roles.description: I was assigned to develop an iOS app. We used Flutter on iPad and iPhone, and I also deployed the application to the App Store.

roles.title: Hybrid Software Engineer / Fullstack Mobile Developer
roles.description: I was assigned to develop an Android app using Flutter for the front end, and to create and integrate APIs.

roles.title: Fullstack Software Engineer
roles.description: We developed a self-monitoring app. I was assigned to the front and back of the mobile app using Ionic, and to integrate Laravel APIs.

roles.title: Fullstack Web Developer
roles.description: This was my first assignment building a website. I supported a maintenance project, kept it stable, and enhanced it for the client's needs. Later I assisted the mobile department with APIs.
